ACIDLEMON_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}has a chance to throw his lemon slice, knocking the target back a short distance{STAT}

{FLAVOR}After the rock incident, Dave keeps owing him more and more. 酸液柠檬 is fine with anything at this point: share an ice-cream cone, pay for a bus ticket or heck, just a regular verbal apology. So far he's received a frozen 路障僵尸, a ride to a zombie-infested dead end and wouldn't you know it, another hit on the head with a rock! He closes his interview with "Genies are real, and they're amongst us."
ACIDLEMON_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: 酸液柠檬 shoots corrosive juice that deals extra sour damage to metals and armor. Has a chance to throw a lemon slice for even more damage and a brief knockback.
ACIDLEMON_TOOLTIP: Deals extra damage to metallic or bulky armor and zombies

{FLAVOR}Second cousin to 暗影菇, she doesn't get cool glowy powers when near 月光花. The family always brings it up at gatherings: "Why can't you be more like your cousin?" they say. Ail-mint doesn't know how much longer she can take it.
AILMINT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Ail-mints poison all zombies when planted and provide a temporary boost to all Ail-mint Family plants on the lawn.
AKEE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}each subsequent bounce deals less damage

{FLAVOR}Autonomous Katapulting Ejectomatic Emitter is actively looking for a different acronym for A.K.E.E. because let's face it, "Katapulting" is just not working.
AKEE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: A.K.E.E.s lob projectiles that bounce from zombie to zombie.
AKEE_TOOLTIP: Lobs projectiles that bounce from zombie to zombie.
ALOE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}activates when plant is damaged
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}can't heal 甜菜护卫, 冬青屏障 and 毛茛

{FLAVOR}芦荟 likes to soothe. He likes to alleviate, he likes to restore, he likes to mend. But don't ask him to revive. He's touchy about revival.
ALOE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: 芦荟s heal injured plants to their immediate right.

{FLAVOR}Appease-mint takes great umbrage at the notion that he might back down from a fight. "Yes, my name is 'Appease-mint,' but that has more to do with my affinity towards peas than any disinclination to stand up for my beliefs. Rescind your vile calumny this instant, lest I compose a blistering letter of outrage!"

APPLEMORTAR_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}Apple Mortar blasts three zombies dead in their tracks. SPAF! That'll show 'em! That'll show ALL of them!

APPLEMORTAR_TOOLTIP: 向三行投掷高伤害核心

ASPARAGUS_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Range Details: {STAT}can attack targets in the lane above or below, prioritizes leftmost zombies
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}hovers over ground and water

{FLAVOR}Often confused for his old army captain, Aceparagus has a hard time carving out his own identity. It's hard living in someone else's shadow, almost like this entire aerial assault is a shadow of something urban from a different reality. No, that can't be.

BANANA_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}tap to arm, tap on target tile to fire
{KEYWORD}Range: {STAT}anywhere on lawn
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}on impact, explodes in small area

{FLAVOR}It's important to avoid stereotyping as much as possible. Stereotypes are often flat-out wrong. And also hurtful. But honestly ... 香蕉发射器 is TOTALLY bananas.
BANANA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: 香蕉发射器s can fire explosive bananas at any tile on the lawn.
BANANA_TOOLTIP: Tap on banana, then a tile, to launch explosive banana
BEGONIA_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^8600CC^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration.

{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}fire spike leaf pierces through 2 zombies, makes them Lovesick and lowers their damage; ice spike leaf pierces through 4 zombies, makes them Heartbreak and chills them
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}chill effect can't be removed by fire damage
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}zombies hit with both the fire and ice spike leaf get Heartbroken and take more damage from attacks
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}spike leaf deals extra 40 damage if zombies have other spike leaf effect
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}hovers over ground and water

{FLAVOR}When three universes crashed together, not only was untold Zombie chaos unleashed within the Lunar Rainbow Market, but a very powerful plant was born to combat the crisis. Begonia is a plant only said in legend, and came into being to stop the Zombie scourge once and for all. Strange that the last collision didn't wake her up, though.
BEGONIA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Begonias randomly throw two types of spike leaves that can stack to increase damage taken by zombies.
BEGONIA_TOOLTIP: Throws icy and fiery spike leaves that increase damage taken by zombies
BIRTTHDAYZ_INHIBITOR_DESCRIPTION: 生日趴 zombies join the party!
BLASTBERRY_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}爆浆藤 snickers to himself. He imagines lobbing bomblets. He’s been reading up on it and he knows it’s gonna make a big splash when it happens. "Soon," he whispers.
BLASTBERRY_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: 爆浆藤s can be planted on top of other plants to provide increased defense and an additional attack in the form of lobbed projectiles that break into explosive bomblets.
BLASTBERRY_TOOLTIP: 保护内部植物并投掷伤害浆果
BLOCKOLI_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Range Details: {STAT}can attack targets in the lane above or below
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}cannot be dug by 挖掘机僵尸 or pulled by 渔夫僵尸
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}blocks flying zombies

{FLAVOR}Blockoli isn't afraid of being eaten, that's life on the battlefield. What he does fear however, is not being tasty when it does eventually happen. He fancies himself as quite a delicious plant when prepared right, and to deny that potential would be a great insult. As a matter of fact, he's willing to offer tips and suggestions on how it could be done during his off time. His fellow greens aren't as enthusiastic as him on the topic of how they could be prepared for a dish in some water cooler talks, however.
BLOCKOLI_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Blockoli dual-wields two sturdy floret shields, slamming them down to stun and block approaching zombies.
BLOOMERANG_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}As the first new member to your home defense team, 回旋镖射手 enjoys long walkabouts with his friend, Koala Bear, and listening to his Bob Barley albums out back.
BLOOMERANG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: 回旋镖射手s can hit multiple targets in their lane, twice each coming and going!
BLOOMERANG_PLANTFOOD: Throws many boomerangs that hit all the zombies to the left, right, above, and below.
BLOOMERANG_TOOLTIP: Hits up to three targets in its lane, twice
BLOOMINGHEARTS_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}40 (projectile), 15 per damage stack
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}damage increases across multiple 心花怒放s

{FLAVOR}心花怒放 loves zombies. She gets guff from her fellow plants over it, but she stands firm. She's into zombies and makes no apologies about it.
BLOOMINGHEARTS_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: 心花怒放s lob projectiles that infatuate zombies, causing increasing damage the more they hit.
BLOOMINGHEARTS_TOOLTIP: Lobs projectiles that do more damage the more they hit
BLOVER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, instant
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}blows away all flying zombies

{FLAVOR}The luckiest stunt clover around, 三叶草 is the most recent recipient of the Stunty Award. You can see his work in "Bulb Fiction," "Rooty," and "Finding Flower." He also teaches a stunt class on Tuesdays at the community center.
BLOVER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: 三叶草s blow away all zombies in the air.
BLOVER_TOOLTIP: Blows away all flying and floating zombies
BOINGSETTA_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}heavily damages various grid items
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}destroys critters

{FLAVOR}弹跳秋海棠's a springy plant whose positive outlook is infectiously delightful! The chilling effect is merely a secondary consequence.
BOINGSETTA_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: 弹跳秋海棠s slam the ground in a "boing" that heavily damages grid items and chills zombies.
BOINGSETTA_TOOLTIP: Damages grid items and chills zombies
BOMBARDMINT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Bombard-mint Family Plants:
{STAT}香蕉发射器
{STAT}Berry Blaster
{STAT}Bombegranate
{STAT}樱桃炸弹
{STAT}Dandelion
{STAT}遁地根
{STAT}爆炸坚果
{STAT}幽灵辣椒
{STAT}Grapeshot
{STAT}土豆地雷
{STAT}原始土豆地雷
{STAT}Strawburst

{FLAVOR}"Explosions are fun," says Bombard-mint with an impish twinkle in her eye. "In the context of eliminating zombies, a cascade of detonations not only clears much of the board, but leaves a lovely fragrance in its wake. It smells like... victory."
BOMBARDMINT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Bombard-mints set off a massive explosion on board and provide a temporary boost to all Bombard-mint Family plants on the lawn.
BOMBEGRANATE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, instant

{FLAVOR}Bombegranate is explosive, but she likes to think there's more to her than that. She's also deciduous and exarillate!
BOMBEGRANATE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Bombegranates explode and leave 3x3 grids of exploding seeds that damage zombies.
BOMBEGRANATE_TOOLTIP: 爆炸并留下会爆炸的种子
BONKCHOY_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can attack ahead or behind

{FLAVOR}A freelance dentist on the side, he's offering a special this month - he'll knock two of your teeth out for the price of one!
BONKCHOY_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: 拳击卷心菜s rapidly punch nearby enemies that are ahead or behind them.
BONKCHOY_PLANTFOOD: Attacks with a flurry of fists, doing massive damage to anything on nearby tiles.
BONKCHOY_TOOLTIP: Rapidly punches enemies ahead or behind
BOOMFLOWER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}tap or drag from 爆气球花 to move a balloon to a tile
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}balloons gain an additional 300 damage per stack

{FLAVOR}爆气球花's balloons are inflated with hydrogen and aerosolized kerosene. It's an anti-safety measure.
BOOMFLOWER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: 爆气球花s spawn exploding balloons that can be placed anywhere on the lawn as traps for zombies.
BOOMFLOWER_TOOLTIP: Tap to place a mine, mines can be stacked for more damage
BOOST_ALREADY_ACTIVE: This plant is already boosted! Use it in a level!
BOOST_DETAIL_BOUNTY_HUNTER: Zombies defeated by this plant drop coins. This boost lasts for 1 level.
BOOST_DETAIL_EXTRA_TOUGH: Extra protection from zombies. This boost lasts for 1 level.
BOOST_DETAIL_FAST_RECHARGE: Recharges more quickly. This boost lasts for 1 level.
BOOST_DETAIL_FIRST_STRIKE: Gets free Plant Food effect when planted. This boost lasts for 1 level.
BOOST_DETAIL_RAPID_FIRE: Attacks at a faster rate. This boost lasts for 1 level.
BOOST_DETAIL_SHOVEL_BOMB: Explodes when shoveled. This boost lasts for 1 level.
BOOST_DETAIL_SUN_DISCOUNT: Costs less sun to plant. This boost lasts for 1 level.
BOSS_BUSTER_CANNON_DESCRIPTION: Inflicts up to {DAMAGE} damage to bosses every {TIME} seconds!
BOWLINGBULB_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Damage Details: {STAT}larger bulbs do more damage

{FLAVOR}Guess which team has won the League Championship for five years running now? Team Bowling Bulb, that's who. They are on a ROLL. You and your pals think you got what it takes to stop 'em? Yeah, sure. Keep dreamin, bub.
BOWLINGBULB_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Bowling Bulbs roll shots that can bounce into multiple zombies.
BOWLINGBULB_TOOLTIP: Rolls bouncing shots that can hit multiple zombies
BRAMBLEBUSH_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}can pull the armor off certain zombies when trapped
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}berry clusters show traps remaining

{FLAVOR}Many friends and family members advised him to pursue a different career, something more along the lines of viticulture along with the other vines, with him being told that his current career is a trap. He never thought they were so literal about it until he graduated, but he never had the best hindsight.
BRAMBLEBUSH_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Bramble Bush traps and damages a zombie.
BUTTERCUP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}creates buttering butter splats

{FLAVOR}毛茛's sweet as can be, but she packs a wallop! "I'm not cheap," she says, referring to her flat 25 sun cost. "I'm reasonable."
BUTTERCUP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: 毛茛 butters butter onto attacking zombies, stunning them with butter. Butter!
CABBAGEPULT_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}卷心菜投手 received his doctorate in pulting from Harvest University. He knows a thing or two about launching his way to the top. He also makes a mean soup.
CABBAGEPULT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: 卷心菜投手s hurl cabbages at the enemy.
CABBAGEPULT_PLANTFOOD: Hits every zombie on the lawn with a large cabbage.
CABBAGEPULT_TOOLTIP: Hurls cabbages over obstacles at the enemy
CACTUS_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}hides and does ground damage when zombies are near

{FLAVOR}Things have really changed for Cactus lately. Book deals, movies, truck show appearances... she’s just trying to focus on staying humble and launching thorns like always.
CACTUS_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Cactus fires a penetrating thorn that can damage multiple enemies!
CACTUS_TOOLTIP: Fires a penetrating thorn, hides for ground damage
CALENDAR_STREAK_RETENTION_CALL_TO_ACTION: Yowsers, your calendar streak's at risk! Spend gems to keep it?
CALENDAR_UNLOCK_DESCRIPTION:
- Earn rewards each day by opening Plants vs Zombies 2!
- Earn extra rewards during Seasonal Events.
- This feature requires a network connection.
CAMEL_MINIGAME_TUTORIAL_1: Tap on a zombie to flip its panel
CAMEL_MINIGAME_TUTORIAL_2: Great! Now tap on another one
CAMEL_MINIGAME_TUTORIAL_3: Awesome! Keep matching symbols to win the game
CANNON_TUTORIAL_1: Tap on the coconut cannon to make it fire
CANNON_TUTORIAL_2: Great! Now blow up as many zombies as you can
CARAMELPOPCORN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}kernels deal splash damage on a single tile and slow zombies on impact
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}bags of popcorn deal splash damage and slow zombies in an area around them

{FLAVOR}"Me and 玉米投手? We're on good terms," she answers. "I fling caramel and he flings butter, but we both look for the same results, work towards the same goal. I'm tired of people trying to create fake drama, who said that you can't mix sweet with salty?"
CARAMELPOPCORN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Caramel Popcorn lobs zombie-slowing caramelized corn kernels and bags of popcorn.
CARAMELPOPCORN_TOOLTIP: Flings caramelized corn kernels and popcorn bags at zombies
CAULDRON_TUTORIAL_1: Feed Plant Food into the Cauldron.
CAULDRON_TUTORIAL_2: Good! When fed Plant Food, the Cauldron will boil and dispense free Plants.
CAULDRON_TUTORIAL_3: When depleted of all its packets, the Cauldron will explode, removing it from the lawn. Try placing the seed packets down!
CAULDRON_TUTORIAL_4: Great job! Using Plant Food on a Cauldron that's already boiling will extend its duration.
CAULIPOWER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}hovers over ground and water

{FLAVOR}花椰菜武帝's eyes spin with distress. He's just thought of a really great ending for his novel, but he's afraid his cousin won't understand it.
CAULIPOWER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: 花椰菜武帝s use their mental powers to hypnotize random zombies and turn them against their former friends.

CDN_DOWNLOAD_PROGRESS_DESCRIPTION: Downloading update data. The game will return to the Main Menu when the download is complete.

CDN_ERROR_IN_PROGRESS: There is already a download in progress.
CDN_RETRY_DESCRIPTION: You can retry the download, or cancel and not proceed to the feature.
CELERYSTALKER_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}芹菜潜行者 resents the implication that there’s anything unsavory about his attack style. He simply believes that discretion is the better part of vegetation.
CELERYSTALKER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: 芹菜潜行者s wait until zombies pass, then pop up and bash them from behind.
CELERYSTALKER_TOOLTIP: Pops up and bashes zombies from behind
CELLULAR_PERMISSION_BODY: Do you want to use cellular data to download additional content? You can change this setting in the options menu later.
CHARDGUARD_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}You might remember 甜菜护卫 from his days in the WWF (that's World Wrestling Foliage). When he was in the ring – boy-oh-boy – he was something to behold! His moves! His style! His attitude! The crowd loved him. He was quite the star for a while there. Sure, those days are behind him. But if you watch carefully, when 甜菜护卫 is fighting zombies, you'll see him use the wrestling move he made famous. The ol' Knock 'Em Dead maneuver – it gets 'em every time.
CHARDGUARD_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: 甜菜护卫s are defensive blockers that can hurl zombies backwards.
CHARDGUARD_PLANTFOOD: Returns to full health, then damages and pushes back zombies in 6 adjacent tiles.
CHEESESTRAWBERRY_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}^F17925^Part of the Lunar Rainbow Market collaboration, originating from PvZ 2 SHUTTLE.

{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}zombies hit with the cheese deal less damage to plants

{FLAVOR}Cheese Strawberry wasn't supposed to be here. He slipped into a parcel and stowed away when the Jinjin Tea Shop sent it out to a mysterious customer, and thus sent him on an interdimensional trip to a world unlike anything he saw before. But that didn't matter much to him, because all that did was give him a free trip to try the new foreign cheese! How could you say no to that?
CHEESESTRAWBERRY_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Cheese Strawberry lobs smelly cheese that makes zombies nauseated, lowering their eating damage.
CHEESESTRAWBERRY_TOOLTIP: Lobs smelly cheese that lowers zombie eating damage
CHERRY_BOMB_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, instant

{FLAVOR}The 樱桃炸弹 Brothers attempted to start their own band. "We tried to figure out what the sound would be, but we kept explodonating speakers, stages, fans, and of course, zombies. Look for our LP next year."
CHERRY_BOMB_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: 樱桃炸弹s can blow up all zombies in an area. They have a short fuse so plant them near zombies.
CHERRY_BOMB_TOOLTIP: Blows up all zombies in a medium area
CHILIBEAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, on being eaten
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}eating zombie is destroyed and releases stunning gas
{KEYWORD}Weakness: {STAT}can't affect mechanical zombies

{FLAVOR}He's not blushing, he's trying to hold it in.
CHILIBEAN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Chili Beans deliver a crippling bout of gastrointestinal distress.
CHILIBEAN_PLANTFOOD: Launches out 3 Chili Bean clones to random locations on the lawn.
CHILIBEAN_TOOLTIP: Zombies that eat it are defeated and release gas
CHOMPER_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}takes 12 seconds to swallow a zombie
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}deals damage to zombies that can't be devoured

{FLAVOR}Everyone appreciates what 大嘴花 does. His appetite has saved them on numerous occasions. But truth be told, 大嘴花's friends think that eating zombies is gross. And his breath! No one has the heart to tell him, and he never gets the hint when you offer him a mint.
CHOMPER_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: 大嘴花s can devour a zombie whole, but they are vulnerable while chewing.
CHOMPER_TOOLTIP: 吞掉一只僵尸，然后咀嚼一段时间
CITRON_DESCRIPTION: {FLAVOR}As the owner and primary user of "Vitamin C-U-Later" 20-hour energy shots, 柠檬 is always on and always ready for action. "Let's make this happen!!"
CITRON_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: 柠檬s shoot powerful balls of plasma.
CLAIM_X_JOUST_FREE_PLAYS_DESC: Claim {COUNT} Arena Free Plays, get gems!
COCONUTCANNON_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}tap to fire
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}on impact, explodes in medium area

{FLAVOR}Sure, he's a hairy old man, but 椰子大炮 can still fire on all cylinders. The reason he's so hairy: he's in-between waxings.
COCONUTCANNON_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: 椰子大炮s fire down a single lane, causing a medium explosion on impact.
COCONUTCANNON_PLANTFOOD: Fires a huge cannonball that pushes the zombies it hits to the right side of the lawn and then explodes.
COCONUTCANNON_TOOLTIP: Tap on the cannon to fire an explosive coconut
COFFEEBEAN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Usage: {STAT}single use, instant
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}plants affected by buff attack faster until effect runs out
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}can be planted on top of other plants
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}hovers over ground and water

{FLAVOR}The current spokesman for an energy drink owned by Rodeo Legend Zombies, Coffee Bean has considered stepping down after the unintended side-effects of a viral marketing campaign have taken a toll on him.
COFFEEBEAN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Coffee Bean wakes up plants in a 3x3 area.
COFFEEBEAN_TOOLTIP: Wakes up plants in a 3x3 area
COIN_STORE_TEXT: You need more coins.  Choose a package below.
COLDSNAPDRAGON_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Area: {STAT}slows and damages zombies in the 6 tiles in front of it

{FLAVOR}寒冰龙草 gets chilly when anyone brings up his cousin 龙舌兰. "We just view temperature very differently, and I'd really rather not discuss it," he says. Yikes.
COLDSNAPDRAGON_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: 寒冰龙草s breathe icy mist into 6 adjacent tiles.
COMMUNITY_QUEST_DESC_FEASTIVUS_1: Treasure Yetis are overrunning 盛宴节! Defeat them to win 100 Cold plant seed packets and contribute to the Community Challenge!
COMMUNITY_QUEST_GRAPESHOT_DESC_60: Play with Grapeshot to win 60 Grapeshot seed packets and contribute to the Community Challenge!
COMMUNITY_QUEST_INZANITY_DESC: Play a fresh crop of inzane, organically-grown levels and contribute to the Community Challenge!
COMMUNITY_QUEST_TOADSTOOL_DESC_60: Play with 蟾蜍菇 to win 60 蟾蜍菇 seed packets and contribute to the Community Challenge!
COMMUNITY_QUEST_TOADSTOOL_TITLE: Community Challenge Epic Quest: 蟾蜍菇!
CONCEALMINT_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Conceal-mint Family Plants:
{STAT}黄昏投手
{STAT}墓碑玫瑰
{STAT}月光花
{STAT}雾气澳洲坚果
{STAT}夜幕菇
{STAT}暗影豌豆
{STAT}暗影菇

{FLAVOR}Conceal-mint ducks ninja-like out of the party without telling a soul. "Where's Conceal-mint?" ask the other plants. They don't know. Nobody does. Conceal-mint is just that sneaky.
CONCEALMINT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Conceal-mints power up all shadow plants on the lawn, drag some number of zombies to their doom, and provide an additional temporary boost to Conceal-mint Family plants.
CONTAGIOUSPOISON: Apply Shadow Boosted 暗影菇's poison to

{STAT}树汁苗

{STAT}Stallia

{STAT}Tumbleweed

{FLAVOR}"Go easy, there," says Contain-mint. "No need to be in such a rush all the time. Movement is totally overrated."
CONTAINMINT_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Contain-mints stun all zombies on the board and provide a temporary boost to all Contain-mint Family plants on the lawn.
